details.eligibility: Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics (or relevant) engineering, or B.Sc. for DMS/CMA posts. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: CBT 1: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. CBT 2: 150 questions, 150 marks, 120 minutes (Technical + non-technical). Negative marking 1/3. Then Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Technical subjects (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics), Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, General Science.
details.important_dates: CEN 03/2024: CBT 1 held 16-18 Dec 2024; CBT 2 held 22 Apr 2025 and re-exam 4 Jun 2025. Next JE cycle CBT 1 held 19-20 & 25 Feb 2026; answer key released 10 Nov 2026.

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. YES, a 2025 cycle happened: CEN 03/2024 — CBT 1 held 16-18 Dec 2024, CBT 2 held 22 Apr 2025 (all streams) with a Civil re-exam on 4 Jun 2025. Years by HELD date, so CBT 2 is recorded as 2025. A new JE cycle followed: CBT 1 held 19-20 & 25 Feb 2026. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals; the Testbook CBT 2 papers are explicitly memory-based.
